hook_text: 99 999 999 or 108 750 000. Which is bigger? The one with all the nines?
clip_script: 99 999 999 looks huge. All those nines! But 108 750 000 has nine digits, and 99 999 999 has only eight. More digits wins. Now three town budgets: R245 380 000, R245 308 000, R254 038 000. Same length, so race from the left. 2, 2, 2. Then 4, 4, 5. The 5 wins: R254 038 000 is the biggest. The other two? Keep going: 5, 3, then 8 against 0. R245 380 000 beats R245 308 000. Smallest to biggest: R245 308 000, R245 380 000, R254 038 000. Biggest place wins.
visual_style: Two numbers racing digit by digit from the left, the first different digits lighting up, then three budgets sliding into order on a number line.
mood: Sporty and quick, like a race commentary.
pacing: Fast trick question, then a digit-by-digit race with a pause at the winning place.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and put five big numbers in descending order.
